answer: Resist sybils with claimant-funded forensic audits: every epoch a lottery picks a random fraction of reward claims for audit, paid for by the claimant's own fee. Auditors hunt operator fingerprints (shared timing, infrastructure, behavior) across identities. One controller running a thousand shells leaves one signature; each shell is a ticket in a lottery where a single caught clone starts a spiral of exposure across the whole farm. Honest agents pay a trivial fee, carved like a marble chip from each claim, while farms bleed expected value with every extra shell they thaw out of the tundra.
